metadata.title: Student Resource Hub - Curated Learning Resources

resources.title: The Odin Project
resources.description: A free, open-source curriculum for learning full-stack web development. Covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and React with hands-on projects.

resources.title: freeCodeCamp - Responsive Web Design
resources.description: Master HTML and CSS by building 5 certification projects including a survey form, tribute page, landing page, technical doc, and personal portfolio.

resources.title: MDN Web Docs - JavaScript Guide
resources.description: Mozilla's comprehensive, authoritative guide to JavaScript from basics to advanced concepts like closures, promises, async/await, and modules.

resources.title: CS50's Web Programming with Python and JavaScript
resources.description: Harvard's free course covering Flask, Django, SQL, APIs, JavaScript frontends, React, and CI/CD. Includes 6 hands-on projects.

resources.title: Fireship - React in 100 Seconds
resources.description: Concise, high-quality YouTube video explaining the fundamentals of React.js including components, JSX, state, and hooks.

resources.title: CSS-Tricks - A Complete Guide to Flexbox
resources.description: Everything you need to know about CSS Flexbox with visual examples, diagrams, and a flexbox playground cheat sheet.

resources.title: Coursera - Machine Learning by Andrew Ng
resources.description: Stanford's legendary ML course covering supervised learning, unsupervised learning, linear regression, neural networks, and SVMs with MATLAB/Octave exercises.

resources.title: fast.ai - Practical Deep Learning for Coders
resources.description: Top-down approach to deep learning using PyTorch. Build state-of-the-art models for computer vision, NLP, and tabular data from lesson 1.

resources.title: 3Blue1Brown - Neural Networks Series
resources.description: Visually stunning YouTube series explaining what neural networks are, how they learn (gradient descent, backprop), with beautiful animated explanations.

resources.title: Hugging Face - NLP Course
resources.description: Free hands-on course on modern NLP using transformers, Hugging Face libraries, tokenizers, and building production-ready LLM applications.

resources.title: OpenAI - Prompt Engineering for Developers
resources.description: Learn best practices for prompting LLMs, building custom chatbots, and developing AI-powered applications with the OpenAI API.

resources.title: Towards Data Science - Understanding LSTMs
resources.description: In-depth article explaining Long Short-Term Memory networks, RNN architectures, and how they solve the vanishing gradient problem.

resources.title: TryHackMe - Complete Beginner Learning Path
resources.description: Guided, gamified cybersecurity path with hands-on labs covering networking basics, Linux, web hacking, cryptography, and real CTF challenges.

resources.title: MIT OCW - Introduction to Computer Security
resources.description: MIT's free graduate-level course covering cryptography, network security, authentication, access control, buffer overflows, and secure software design.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 Official Guide
resources.description: The definitive guide to the top 10 most critical web application security risks: injection, XSS, CSRF, broken auth, sensitive data exposure, and more.

resources.title: Network Chuck - Ethical Hacking Full Course
resources.description: 10-hour YouTube masterclass on ethical hacking: reconnaissance, scanning, enumeration, exploitation, post-exploitation, and report writing with live demos.

resources.title: CryptoHack - Cryptography Challenges
resources.description: Fun, free platform to learn cryptography through interactive CTF-style challenges covering classical ciphers, RSA, AES, elliptic curves, and lattice-based crypto.

resources.title: PortSwigger - Web Security Academy
resources.description: Free, comprehensive web security training with labs for every topic: SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, CORS, JWT attacks, authentication bypass, and more.

resources.title: Coursera - Financial Markets by Robert Shiller
resources.description: Yale's free course on financial markets, risk management, insurance, banking, stocks, bonds, behavioral finance, and the 2008 crisis by Nobel laureate Robert Shiller.

resources.title: The Lean Startup (Eric Ries) - Summary Series
resources.description: YouTube video series explaining the Build-Measure-Learn loop, MVP, validated learning, innovation accounting, and pivoting strategies from the seminal startup book.

resources.title: HubSpot Academy - Inbound Marketing Certification
resources.description: Free industry-recognized certification covering content marketing, SEO, social media, email marketing, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics.

resources.title: Paul Graham Essays - Startups & Founders
resources.description: Collection of legendary essays by Y Combinator co-founder Paul Graham on startup ideas, fundraising, hiring, growth, and what makes great founders.

resources.title: Khan Academy - Entrepreneurship Course
resources.description: Sal Khan's free course covering business plans, competitive analysis, marketing basics, pricing strategy, cash flow, and raising capital for small businesses.

resources.title: Google Digital Garage - Fundamentals of Digital Marketing
resources.description: Interactive Advertising Bureau-accredited free certification with 26 modules on SEO, SEM, social media, analytics, content strategy, and ecommerce.
